notes: Weather. Late-season games in the Midwest, Northeast and Mid-Atlantic can bring snow, rain, wind or bitter cold; September in the South brings heat. It shows on the matchup card and in the broadcast, and it changes the edge: air it out in the snow and pay for it, ground and pound and gain, conditioning weeks pay off in the heat, warm-weather teams shiver on the road in November. Coach's guide tips for flips, the portal window, media days and the late signing period.
